name: Waydroid
description: Waydroid's reviewed manual upgrade path downloads newer system and vendor images and compares each ZIP's SHA-256 with the corresponding ID supplied by its OTA channel response before extraction. The reviewed code does not establish independently signed channel metadata or the complete provenance of released images.
limitations: The checkout is a newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout.
The source shows channel-provided hash comparison but no independent signature or authenticated metadata control in this reviewed path.
The helper's HTTP transport and deployment configuration were not treated as publisher authentication evidence.
